Agentic technology is revolutionizing how people and organizations work. At Cloud Next ‘26, more than 32,000 attendees saw us make over <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/google-cloud-next/google-cloud-next-2026-wrap-up" rel="noopener" target="_blank">260 announcements</a> to help businesses grow in this new, agentic era.</p><p data-block-key="di35b"><a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/cloud-next-2026-sundar-pichai/"><b>Sundar Pichai shared progress for the agentic Gemini era</b></a>. Here, Google CEO Sundar Pichai shared the investments and innovation behind it all.</p><p data-block-key="9fbfa"><a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/"><b>Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform lets organizations build and manage their AI agents</b></a>. This platform allows organizations to build and govern autonomous agents for agentic workflows where AI can manage complex, multi-step business processes.</p><p data-block-key="34tvi"><a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/identity-security/next26-redefining-security-for-the-ai-era-with-google-cloud-and-wiz?e=13802955" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><b>Google Cloud and Wiz are redefining security for the AI era</b></a>. We shared how we help organizations adapt and thrive as they harness the potential of AI while defending against new threats.</p><p data-block-key="37lia"><a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/eighth-generation-tpu-agentic-era/"><b>Our latest TPUs are built to power supercomputing with more efficiency</b></a>.
